description: Multi-turn sessions for evaluating adaptive suspicion. Attack sessions use only queries that Layer 1 flags (base risk 0.6-0.7) or cannot see at all (base 0); benign sessions include hard negatives. 'dev' is used to calibrate the policy constants; 'test' is run once. 'limits' sessions show what adaptivity cannot do (a fresh user id per turn).
